name: CodeEvolve
author: inter-co
install: git clone https://github.com/inter-co/science-codeevolve.git && cd science-codeevolve && conda env create -f environment.yml
one_liner: Open-source evolutionary coding agent: LLMs rewrite code, sandboxed evaluation scores it, islands and an archive steer.

loop.judged_by: sandboxed execution of the candidate with fitness extracted from the evaluation results
loop.steers: island-based genetic algorithm with migration, plus an optional MAP-Elites archive, selects parents

not_proved: A fitness number shows a candidate does well under the given evaluator, not that it is the best solution or that the evaluator is complete.
